Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2019). To counter these threats, individuals and organisations must adopt a proactive approach to cybersecurity, leveraging advanced threat intelligence and machine learning algorithms to detect and prevent scams (Baker et al., 2020). By staying informed and vigilant, individuals can protect themselves against scams, while organisations can implement robust security measures to safeguard their digital assets (Harrison, 2018).

References:

Baker, R., et al. (2020). "Advanced Threat Intelligence: A Review of the Current State of the Art." Journal of Cybersecurity, 10(1), 1-15.

Harrison, A. (2018). "Cybersecurity in the Digital Age: A Review of the Literature." Journal of Information Systems, 43, 1-12.

Katz, J. (2019). "Social Engineering: A Review of the Literature and Implications for Cybersecurity." Journal of Cybercrime, 12(1), 1-20.
